title: Temporal Specification Guidance for Text-to-Video Generation
title_zh: 文本到视频生成的时序规范引导

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video models often generate the visual concepts requested in natural language prompts but fail to satisfy their intended ordering, timing, and persistence requirements. We propose representing these requirements as specifications in a formal Temporal Logic, and introduce Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG) , a training-free inference-time framework that turns temporal specifications into executable objectives for guiding video generation during sampling. TSG scores traces of visual concept evidence using differentiable quantitative semantics and uses the score’s gradients to construct a specification-guided denoising direction. We instantiate this framework with video–text attention traces, efficient differentiable scores for Metric Temporal Logic, and gradient-derived attention biases. This instantiation requires neither an external concept classifier nor backpropagation through the video transformer. Its attention-steered forward pass yields a denoising direction that augments classifier-free guidance (CFG). On a benchmark of 220 prompts spanning 11 categories of temporal constraints, including ordered object entry and state transitions, this instantiation improves specification satisfaction accuracy over CFG by 9.5–20 percentage points across five models, with minimal memory overhead. These results demonstrate the potential of temporal specifications and differentiable satisfaction objectives as a flexible interface for controlling video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 文生视频模型通常能够生成自然语言提示所要求的视觉概念，却无法满足这些概念预期的顺序、时机与持续性要求。 我们提出将这些要求表示为形式化时序逻辑中的规范，并引入时序规范引导（Temporal Specification Guidance, TSG），这是一个免训练的推理时框架，可将时序规范转化为可执行的目标，以便在采样过程中引导视频生成。 TSG 使用可微的定量语义对视觉概念证据的轨迹进行评分，并利用该分数的梯度构建规范引导的去噪方向。 我们通过视频—文本注意力轨迹、面向度量时序逻辑的高效可微分数，以及由梯度导出的注意力偏置，对该框架进行了实例化。 这一实例化既不需要外部概念分类器，也不需要通过视频 Transformer 进行反向传播。 其由注意力引导的前向传播产生一个去噪方向，用于增强无分类器引导（CFG）。 在一个包含 220 个提示、涵盖 11 类时序约束（包括对象的有序出现与状态转换）的基准上，该实例化在五个模型上将规范满足准确率较 CFG 提升了 9.5–20 个百分点，且内存开销极小。 这些结果表明，时序规范与可微的满足度目标有望成为控制视频生成的一种灵活接口。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-Video generation has seen tremendous progress in recent years, with models such as Gemini Omni ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , Runway Gen ( Esser et al., 2023 ; Runway, 2025 ) , Wan ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , and CogVideoX ( Yang et al., 2025 ) producing videos with improved visual quality and semantic fidelity. Classifier-Free Guidance ( Ho & Salimans, 2022 ) was introduced to improve adherence to natural language prompts in image generation and is now widely adopted by video generation models ( Ho et al., 2022b ; Ho et al., 2022a ) . However, adherence to temporal constraints remains challenging ( Choi et al., 2025 ; Schiber et al., 2026 ) . Figure 1 shows two examples of such failures with CogVideoX-5B. While the model broadly incorporates the semantic concepts described in the text prompts (e.g., the presence of a traffic light or a drone), it fails to follow the required ordering, persistence, and timing requirements. In these examples, the model misses the intended timed color progression and the eventual appearance of a hiker or a flare signal, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 文生视频生成近年来取得了巨大进展，Gemini Omni（Google DeepMind，2026）、Runway Gen（Esser 等，2023；Runway，2025）、Wan（Wan 等，2025）和 CogVideoX（Yang 等，2025）等模型生成的视频在视觉质量和语义保真度方面均有提升。 无分类器引导（Classifier-Free Guidance）（Ho & Salimans，2022）最初被提出用于提升图像生成中对自然语言提示的遵循度，如今已被视频生成模型广泛采用（Ho 等，2022b；Ho 等，2022a）。 然而，对时间约束的遵循仍然具有挑战性（Choi 等，2025；Schiber 等，2026）。 图 1 展示了 CogVideoX-5B 出现此类失败的两个例子。 尽管该模型大体上融入了文本提示中描述的语义概念（例如，红绿灯或无人机的出现），但它未能遵循所需的顺序、持续性和时序要求。 在这些例子中，模型分别未能呈现预期的定时颜色渐变，以及徒步者或信号弹的最终出现。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose expressing temporal requirements as specifications in formal Temporal Logics. Formal temporal specifications can precisely express requirements that are implicitly described in natural language prompts. Frame-level visual concepts, such as the presence of a traffic light or the associated colors, can be represented as atomic propositions. Temporal Logics offer standard Boolean operators (negation, conjunction, and disjunction) and temporal operators such as Always ( 𝐆 \mathbf{G} ), Until ( 𝐔 \mathbf{U} ), and Eventually ( 𝐅 \mathbf{F} ) to express persistence and ordering requirements. In this work, we present a specification language adopted from Metric Temporal Logic ( Koymans, 1990 ) to express temporal requirements with different degrees of timing precision. Representations of temporal requirements from prior work, including timed binary masks ( Schiber et al., 2026 ) and untimed Temporal Logic formulae ( Choi et al., 2025 ) , can also be written as specifications in this language.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出将时间需求表达为形式化时序逻辑中的规约。 形式化的时序规约能够精确表达自然语言提示中隐含描述的需求。 帧级视觉概念，例如红绿灯的存在或其相关颜色，可以表示为原子命题。 时序逻辑提供了标准的布尔运算符（否定、合取和析取）以及诸如 Always（ 𝐆 \mathbf{G} ）、Until（ 𝐔 \mathbf{U} ）和 Eventually（ 𝐅 \mathbf{F} ）等时序算子，以表达持续性和顺序性需求。 在本工作中，我们提出了一种借鉴度量时序逻辑（ Koymans, 1990 ）的规约语言，以不同精度的时间要求来表达时间需求。 先前工作中对时间需求的表示，包括带时间的二值掩码（ Schiber et al., 2026 ）和不带时间的时序逻辑公式（ Choi et al., 2025 ），也可以写成这种语言中的规约。

paragraphs.en: We propose Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG), a training-free inference-time framework for improving adherence to temporal specifications with transformer-based video generation models. Our key insight is that temporal specifications provide an executable objective for guiding video generation during sampling. TSG makes this practical through differentiable specification scores and attention interventions that avoid backpropagation through the video transformer. Concretely, TSG computes traces of visual concept evidence using video-text attention from the video transformer. For every attention head, TSG computes biases as gradients of a differentiable specification score, steers the attention scores with these biases, and computes the specification-guided direction from the steered forward pass through the video transformer. Our use of attention as a proxy for visual concept presence builds on prior work on attention-based semantic guidance in image and video generation ( Chefer et al., 2023 ; Schiber et al., 2026 ) . The use of video-text attention mitigates the need for an external concept classifier during generation. Because differentiation is restricted to the attention-derived traces and their specification scores, TSG avoids backpropagation through the video transformer, reducing the associated computational and memory demands.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了时序规范引导（Temporal Specification Guidance, TSG），这是一个无需训练的推理时框架，用于提升基于 Transformer 的视频生成模型对时序规范的遵循度。 我们的核心洞见是，时序规范为在采样过程中引导视频生成提供了一个可执行的目标。 TSG 通过可微的规范得分和注意力干预使这一点得以实现，从而避免了对视频 Transformer 进行反向传播。 具体而言，TSG 利用视频 Transformer 中的视频-文本注意力来计算视觉概念证据的轨迹。 对于每个注意力头，TSG 将偏置计算为可微规范得分的梯度，用这些偏置引导注意力得分，并从经过视频 Transformer 的被引导前向传播中计算出规范引导的方向。 我们将注意力作为视觉概念存在的代理，这一做法建立在图像和视频生成中基于注意力的语义引导的先前工作之上（Chefer et al., 2023；Schiber et al., 2026）。 使用视频-文本注意力避免了在生成过程中需要外部概念分类器。 由于求导仅限于注意力导出的轨迹及其规范得分，TSG 避免了通过视频 Transformer 的反向传播，降低了相应的计算和内存开销。

paragraphs.en: We compute a differentiable specification score over attention traces using a quantitative semantics for Metric Temporal Logic. Inspired by efficient log-domain quantitative semantics for Linear Temporal Logic ( Khare et al., 2025 ) , our quantitative semantics aggregates support for the temporal witnesses and alternatives admitted by a specification. Its log-domain form provides differentiable guidance and can be efficiently evaluated in time linear in trace length for a fixed specification. We establish monotonicity in independent literal-support inputs and predictable concept-score gradient signs under consistent polarity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用度量时序逻辑的定量语义，在注意力轨迹上计算一个可微的规范分数。 受线性时序逻辑的高效对数域定量语义（Khare 等人，2025）的启发，我们的定量语义聚合了规范所允许的时序见证与备选的支持度。 其对数域形式提供了可微的引导，并且在规范固定的情况下，可以在与轨迹长度呈线性关系的时间内高效求值。 我们证明了该分数在独立的字面支持输入上具有单调性，并且在极性一致的情况下概念分数的梯度符号是可预测的。

sents.zh: 我们使用度量时序逻辑的定量语义，在注意力轨迹上计算一个可微的规范分数。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate TSG on a benchmark of 220 prompts spanning temporal constraints from 11 categories, including timed state transitions, entity appearance and disappearance, persistence, and choice. Across five models from the CogVideoX ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and Wan ( Wan et al., 2025 ) families, TSG improves specification satisfaction accuracy by 9.5–20 percentage points over CFG-only sampling. We also evaluate TSG with Wan 2.1 1.3B on strictly-timed prompts from the TempoControl object appearance benchmark ( Schiber et al., 2026 ) , where it outperforms CFG sampling by up to 22 percentage points in temporal accuracy and matches the state-of-the-art method on that benchmark with approximately 62% lower peak GPU memory. Together, these findings support specification-guided attention steering as an effective and memory efficient approach to temporal control in video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在包含 220 个提示词的基准上评估 TSG，这些提示词涵盖 11 个类别的时间约束，包括定时状态转换、实体的出现与消失、持续性以及选择。 在来自 CogVideoX（Yang et al., 2025）和 Wan（Wan et al., 2025）系列的五个模型上，TSG 相比仅使用 CFG 的采样，将规格满足准确率提升了 9.5–20 个百分点。 我们还在来自 TempoControl 物体出现基准（Schiber et al., 2026）的严格定时提示词上使用 Wan 2.1 1.3B 评估了 TSG，其时间准确率相比 CFG 采样最高领先 22 个百分点，并以约低 62% 的峰值 GPU 显存达到该基准上最先进方法的水平。 这些结果共同表明，基于规格引导的注意力引导是视频生成中时间控制的一种有效且节省显存的方法。

paragraphs.en: Natural Language prompts to video generation models discuss the visual concepts that must be present in the video, along with the order and optionally the timing of their appearance. In this section, we discuss a formal specification language for these constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 面向视频生成模型的自然语言提示词描述视频中必须出现的视觉概念，以及它们出现的顺序，可选地还包括出现的时间点。 在本节中，我们讨论一种用于表达这些约束的形式化规范语言。

sents.en: Natural Language prompts to video generation models discuss the visual concepts that must be present in the video, along with the order and optionally the timing of their appearance.
sents.zh: 面向视频生成模型的自然语言提示词描述视频中必须出现的视觉概念，以及它们出现的顺序，可选地还包括出现的时间点。

sents.en: In this section, we discuss a formal specification language for these constraints.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们讨论一种用于表达这些约束的形式化规范语言。

Let C C denote the set of all frame-level visual concepts of interest. Examples of such visual concepts include entity presence (e.g., traffic light), entity states (e.g., the color red), and settings with properties (e.g., sky at dusk). We use y ⁡ ( v i , c ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } y(v_{i},c)\in\{0,1\} to denote the presence or absence of the visual concept c c in frame v i v_{i} .

paragraphs.en: This specification language can be used to express temporal constraints from recent works, including untimed Temporal Logic (TL) specifications ( Choi et al., 2025 ) and binary temporal masks that prescribe the presence or absence of a visual concept in each frame ( Schiber et al., 2026 ) . Untimed TL specifications can be written with the trivial [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] intervals. A temporal mask can be encoded as a conjunction of Always constraints over intervals where the mask is constant, using c c for presence and ¬ c \neg c for absence. Additionally, we can write specifications that correspond to a set of temporal masks, including the choice between visual concepts and the disappearance of an object within an interval. In other words, a temporal mask corresponds to a given valid trace while our specifications can admit several valid traces.
paragraphs.zh: 该规范语言可用于表达近期工作中的时间约束，包括无时间的时间逻辑（TL）规范（Choi et al., 2025）以及规定每个帧中某一视觉概念是否出现的二值时间掩码（Schiber et al., 2026）。 无时间 TL 规范可以用平凡的 [0,1] 区间来书写。 时间掩码可以编码为在掩码保持不变的各区间上的 Always 约束的合取，其中使用 c 表示出现，使用 ¬c 表示不出现。 此外，我们还可以书写对应于一组时间掩码的规范，包括视觉概念之间的选择以及某一对象在区间内的消失。 换言之，一个时间掩码对应于一条给定的有效轨迹，而我们的规范可以允许多条有效轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We propose Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG), a training-free sampling-time framework that augments CFG with an update direction d k , tsg d_{k,\mathrm{tsg}} guided by the temporal specification φ \varphi . This framework has three components: temporal traces that provide evidence of visual concepts, a differentiable scoring function that evaluates these traces against the specification φ \varphi , and an update mechanism that uses gradients of this score to steer generation. In this work, we compute traces of visual concept evidence using video-text attention within the transformer T θ T_{\theta} , score them against φ \varphi with a differentiable quantitative semantics for M ​ T ​ L f MTL_{f} , and use the gradients as attention logit biases. This attention-steered forward pass produces the specification-guided direction d k , φ d_{k,\varphi} . We present the overall process in Figure 2 and discuss each step in detail now.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出时序规范引导，这是一个无需训练的采样时框架，它在CFG的基础上增加一个由时序规范 φ \varphi 引导的更新方向 d k , tsg d_{k,\mathrm{tsg}} 。 该框架包含三个组件：提供视觉概念证据的时序轨迹、针对规范 φ \varphi 评估这些轨迹的可微评分函数，以及利用该评分的梯度来引导生成的更新机制。 在本工作中，我们使用变换器 T θ T_{\theta} 内的视频-文本注意力计算视觉概念证据的轨迹，用针对 M ​ T ​ L f MTL_{f} 的可微定量语义对照 φ \varphi 对其评分，并将梯度用作注意力logit偏置。 这种注意力引导的前向传播产生了规范引导方向 d k , φ d_{k,\varphi} 。 我们在图2中展示了整体流程，并将在下文详细讨论每个步骤。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by efficient quantitative semantics for Linear Temporal Logic specifications over videos ( Khare et al., 2025 ) , we define an efficient interval-aware sum–product quantitative semantics in log space for M ​ T ​ L f MTL_{f} specifications. Given an MTL specification φ \varphi and concept score traces y ^ ​ ( z t , c ) \hat{y}(z_{t},c) at attention layer ℓ \ell and head h h , we can compute the score y ^ ​ ( z , φ ) \hat{y}(z,\varphi) recursively using Algorithm 1 in Appendix B . Intuitively, conjunction and Always multiply support for their requirements, while disjunction, Eventually, and Until sum support for admissible alternatives or temporal witnesses.

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks primarily focus on untimed constraints, such as state transitions in TC-Bench ( Feng et al., 2024 ) and NeuS-V ( Sharan et al., 2025 ) , and strictly-timed constraints such as TempoControl ( Schiber et al., 2026 ) . To evaluate TSG on interval-timed constraints, we construct a benchmark with 220 text prompts from 11 categories of temporal constraints. These categories are presented in Figure 3 and include variations in the requested timing, ordering, persistence, and choice among visual concepts.
paragraphs.zh: 现有基准主要聚焦于非定时约束（如 TC-Bench（Feng et al., 2024）与 NeuS-V（Sharan et al., 2025）中的状态转移）以及严格定时约束（如 TempoControl（Schiber et al., 2026））。 为了在区间定时约束上评估 TSG，我们构建了一个包含来自 11 类时间约束的 220 条文本提示的基准。 这些类别如图 3 所示，涵盖了在请求的时间、顺序、持续性以及视觉概念选择方面的变化。

sents.zh: 现有基准主要聚焦于非定时约束（如 TC-Bench（Feng et al., 2024）与 NeuS-V（Sharan et al., 2025）中的状态转移）以及严格定时约束（如 TempoControl（Schiber et al., 2026））。

paragraphs.en: We use GPT-5.6-Sol to propose 50 entities spanning objects from VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and background settings, with associated states (e.g., pose of an object, or time of day for a setting). We construct sets of 20 prompts for each temporal constraint category in Figure 3 . We restrict the intervals to halves and thirds within 5–6-second videos, allowing transitions to occur at any point within each interval. Finally, we manually assign temporal specification templates for each category and instruct GPT-5.6-Sol to instantiate the specifications with atomic propositions mapped to respective visual concepts in each prompt. Appendix D provides further details on examples of prompts for each category along with the list of temporal specification templates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 提出涵盖来自 VBench（Huang et al., 2024）的物体和背景场景的 50 个实体，并附带相关状态（例如物体的姿态，或某个场景的时段）。 我们为图 3 中的每个时间约束类别构建了每组 20 个提示词的集合。 我们将区间限制为 5–6 秒视频中的二等分和三等分，允许转场在每段区间内的任意时刻发生。 最后，我们为每个类别手动指定时间规范模板，并指示 GPT-5.6-Sol 通过映射到每个提示词中相应视觉概念的原子命题来实例化这些规范。 附录 D 提供了每个类别的提示词示例以及时间规范模板列表的更多细节。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate text-to-video generation models with CFG sampling as our main baseline. We include five models from two model families: CogVideoX-2B and CogVideoX-5B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Wan2.1 T2V-1.3B, Wan2.2 TI2V-5B, and Wan2.2 T2V A14B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . These models cover both joint video–text attention, used by CogVideoX, and dedicated video-to-text cross-attention, used by Wan. We use the CFG settings recommended by the model providers. On the strictly-timed prompts from the TempoControl benchmark, we also compare TSG against the TempoControl method. We use TSG during the first 15 sampling steps with ρ k , tsg = 1 \rho_{k,\mathrm{tsg}}=1 . Appendices E.1 and E.2 describe the model settings and TSG configuration; Appendices E.3 and E.5 detail the TempoControl comparison and compute measurements.

paragraphs.en: We uniformly sample 21 decoded frames from each video, and evaluate the frame-level presence of a visual concept using Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct . We use the ground-truth semantics of MTL described in Appendix A to compute the specification satisfaction accuracy (Sat Acc.). We also evaluate visual quality of the generated videos using VBench’s MUSIQ-SPAQ imaging quality scorer ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , along with the time taken for generation (latency) and the peak GPU memory allocated to the process. Appendix E.6 provides further details.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 presents the results comparing TSG against CFG-only sampling on the TSG benchmark. TSG improves satisfaction accuracy by 9.5–20 percentage points across models, with Wan 2.2 A14B reporting the highest satisfaction accuracy of 46.8 % 46.8\% with TSG. Interestingly, Wan2.1 1.3B reports a 31.4 % 31.4\% accuracy with TSG compared to Wan2.2 5B’s 25 % 25\% with CFG-only sampling, despite having fewer parameters. We see this pattern more broadly: smaller models with TSG report higher or comparable satisfaction accuracies to larger models with CFG only . On the strictly-timed prompts from the TempoControl benchmark, TSG improves temporal accuracy over CFG-only by 17.6–22.0 percentage points across splits, and exceeds full TempoControl by 2.97 and 0.58 percentage points on the one-object and two-object splits, respectively (Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表1展示了TSG与仅使用CFG采样在TSG基准上的对比结果。 TSG在各模型上将满足准确率提升了9.5至20个百分点，其中Wan 2.2 A14B在TSG下取得了最高的46.8% 46.8\%的满足准确率。 有趣的是，Wan2.1 1.3B在TSG下取得了31.4% 31.4\%的准确率，而参数量更多的Wan2.2 5B在仅使用CFG采样下只有25% 25\%的准确率。 我们在更广泛的范围内观察到这一模式：使用TSG的小模型的满足准确率高于或相当于仅使用CFG的大模型。 在TempoControl基准的严格限时提示词上，TSG在各数据划分上将时间准确率比仅使用CFG提升了17.6至22.0个百分点，并且在单物体和双物体划分上分别超出完整TempoControl 2.97和0.58个百分点（表2）。

paragraphs.en: TSG matches the CFG-only sampling in terms of the peak GPU memory allocated to the model. This is expected as attention steering detaches the computational graph and hence does not need to store gradients with respect to model weights. TSG uses 30.52 GiB versus 79.43 GiB for full TempoControl, a reduction of approximately 62%, as TempoControl optimizes video latents requiring a gradient computation graph through the entire video transformer (Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在分配给模型的峰值 GPU 显存方面，TSG 与仅使用 CFG 的采样相当。 这是符合预期的，因为注意力引导会使计算图脱离连接，因此无需存储关于模型权重的梯度。 TSG 使用 30.52 GiB，而完整版 TempoControl 需要 79.43 GiB，降低了约 62%，因为 TempoControl 对视频潜变量进行优化，需要经过整个视频 Transformer 的梯度计算图（表 2）。

sents.en: TSG matches the CFG-only sampling in terms of the peak GPU memory allocated to the model.
sents.zh: 在分配给模型的峰值 GPU 显存方面，TSG 与仅使用 CFG 的采样相当。

sents.en: This is expected as attention steering detaches the computational graph and hence does not need to store gradients with respect to model weights.
sents.zh: 这是符合预期的，因为注意力引导会使计算图脱离连接，因此无需存储关于模型权重的梯度。

sents.en: TSG uses 30.52 GiB versus 79.43 GiB for full TempoControl, a reduction of approximately 62%, as TempoControl optimizes video latents requiring a gradient computation graph through the entire video transformer (Table 2 ).
sents.zh: TSG 使用 30.52 GiB，而完整版 TempoControl 需要 79.43 GiB，降低了约 62%，因为 TempoControl 对视频潜变量进行优化，需要经过整个视频 Transformer 的梯度计算图（表 2）。

paragraphs.en: The additional specification-guided forward pass through the transformer incurs a latency cost with TSG. This scales with the size of the model as expected, with TSG taking around 1 extra minute with Wan2.1 1.3B to 11 extra minutes with Wan2.2 A14B (Table 1 ). Full TempoControl takes approximately 4.9 × 4.9\times and 3.6 × 3.6\times as long as TSG on the one-object and two-object splits, respectively (Table 2 ). Limiting TempoControl to one optimization round brings its latency close to TSG’s but retains approximately 79.4 GiB peak memory; TSG improves temporal accuracy over this variant by 20.1% and 27.5% relative to its one-object and two-object scores.
paragraphs.zh: 在 TSG 中，额外的由规范引导的 transformer 前向传播会带来延迟开销。 如预期那样，这一开销随模型规模增大，TSG 在 Wan2.1 1.3B 上约多耗时 1 分钟，而在 Wan2.2 A14B 上约多耗时 11 分钟（表 1）。 完整的 TempoControl 在单目标和双目标划分上分别约耗时 4.9 × 4.9\times 和 3.6 × 3.6\times 于 TSG（表 2）。 将 TempoControl 限制为一轮优化可使其延迟接近 TSG，但峰值内存仍约 79.4 GiB；TSG 相对于该变体在其单目标和双目标得分上分别将时间准确性提升了 20.1% 和 27.5%。

paragraphs.en: TSG lowers imaging quality by up to 3.0 3.0 points on four models and improves it by 3.2 3.2 points on Wan2.2 A14B (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: TSG 在四个模型上最多使成像质量降低 3.0 3.0 分，而在 Wan2.2 A14B 上则将其提升 3.2 3.2 分（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 (left) shows category-wise satisfaction accuracies, averaged across five models, with whiskers indicating the minimum and maximum. TSG improves mean accuracy across all 11 categories by approximately 2–43 percentage points. The largest gains occur for alternative final states (23% to 66%), two-state transitions (35% to 71%), and reversible state returns (21% to 43%). Performance nevertheless varies substantially across models: with TSG, accuracy ranges from 20% to 75% for reversible state returns and from 10% to 80% for transitions with a persistent entity. Handover with overlap, triggered responses, and three ordered entries remain challenging, with mean accuracies of approximately 9%, 17%, and 12%, respectively, and gains of only about 2 percentage points. These results show that TSG is particularly effective for state-transition requirements, while coordinating multiple entity appearances, disappearances, and dependencies remains challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 图4（左）展示了各类别的满意度准确率，数值为五个模型的平均值，误差线表示最小值和最大值。 TSG 使全部 11 个类别的平均准确率提升了约 2–43 个百分点。 提升最大的是备选最终状态（23% 到 66%）、双状态转换（35% 到 71%）以及可逆状态回归（21% 到 43%）。 然而，各模型之间的性能差异仍然很大：使用 TSG 后，可逆状态回归的准确率范围为 20% 到 75%，含持久实体的转换的准确率范围为 10% 到 80%。 带重叠的交接、触发响应以及三个有序进入仍然具有挑战性，平均准确率分别约为 9%、17% 和 12%，提升仅约 2 个百分点。 这些结果表明，TSG 对状态转换类需求尤为有效，而协调多个实体的出现、消失及其依赖关系仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: Figures 1 , 2 , and 5 illustrate how TSG improves adherence over CFG-only sampling across temporal requirements from various categories in Figure 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 图 1、图 2 和图 5 展示了 TSG 如何在图 3 中各类别的时间要求上，相比仅使用 CFG 的采样提升了遵循度。

paragraphs.en: We vary the TSG strength ρ ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } \rho\in\{0,1,2,3,4,5\} on a fixed 25-prompt subset per model (top-right in Figure 4 ), with ρ = 0 \rho=0 corresponding to CFG-only sampling. Both models attain their highest satisfaction accuracy at ρ = 1 \rho=1 : 32 % 32\% for Wan2.1 1.3B and 36 % 36\% for Wan2.2 5B, improving over CFG-only by 16 and 12 percentage points, respectively. The accuracy is non-increasing beyond ρ = 1 \rho=1 , and at ρ = 5 \rho=5 it matches or falls below the respective CFG-only baseline. These results support ρ = 1 \rho=1 as the default among the tested strengths on this subset and show that increasing specification guidance beyond this level does not improve adherence. Appendix E.4 provides the sampling configurations and ablation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在每个模型固定的25条提示词子集上变化TSG强度 ρ ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } \rho\in\{0,1,2,3,4,5\}（图4右上部分），其中 ρ = 0 \rho=0 对应仅使用CFG的采样。 两个模型均在 ρ = 1 \rho=1 时取得最高的满足准确率：Wan2.1 1.3B 为 32 % 32\%，Wan2.2 5B 为 36 % 36\%，相比仅使用CFG分别提升了16和12个百分点。 准确率在 ρ = 1 \rho=1 之后不再增加，且在 ρ = 5 \rho=5 时与各自的仅CFG基线持平或更低。 这些结果支持将 ρ = 1 \rho=1 作为该子集上所测试强度中的默认设置，并表明超过这一水平继续增加规格化引导并不能改善遵循度。 附录E.4提供了采样配置和消融实验流程。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether the gains from TSG are an artifact of a higher guidance strength alone, we compare it against CFG with twice the guidance strength (bottom-right in Figure 4 ). We further evaluate the need for the additional prompt-conditional pass by comparing our hybrid CFG + TSG setup against TSG only, and TSG only for the first 15 denoising steps followed by CFG. Combined CFG + TSG reports the highest specification satisfaction accuracies of 32 % 32\% and 36 % 36\% on Wan2.1 1.3B and Wan2.2 5B, respectively. Doubling the CFG strength yields 24 % 24\% and 20 % 20\% , respectively, falling short of combined guidance on both models. The effects of replacing CFG with TSG are mixed across models. These results support our design choice of combining CFG with TSG.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 TSG 带来的提升是否仅仅是更高引导强度的产物，我们将其与引导强度加倍（两倍）的 CFG 进行比较（图 4 右下角）。 我们进一步通过将 CFG + TSG 的混合设置与仅使用 TSG、以及前 15 步去噪使用 TSG 之后使用 CFG 的设置进行比较，来评估额外提示条件前向传递的必要性。 CFG + TSG 组合在 Wan2.1 1.3B 和 Wan2.2 5B 上分别报告了最高的规格满足准确率 32 % 32\% 和 36 % 36\%。 将 CFG 强度加倍分别得到 24 % 24\% 和 20 % 20\%，在两个模型上均不及组合引导。 用 TSG 替换 CFG 的效果在不同模型上表现不一。 这些结果支持我们将 CFG 与 TSG 相结合的设计选择。

paragraphs.en: Methods for controllable video generation differ primarily in terms of the control surface and the time of control (during or post sampling). Control surfaces include spatiotemporal scene layouts ( Lian et al., 2024 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) , and motion transfer using reference videos ( Ling et al., 2024 ) , which are complementary to TSG’s focus on temporal constraints over frame-level visual concepts. Closest to our work, TempoControl ( Schiber et al., 2026 ) aligns concept attention traces with prescribed binary temporal masks by repeatedly optimizing video latents during sampling. TSG offers control over more expressive temporal constraints and outperforms TempoControl on strict-timed traces with lower computational overhead (Table 2 ). Post-sampling temporal control methods include NeuS-E ( Choi et al., 2025 ) that uses Vision Language Models (VLM) to detect visual concepts and feedback from a Temporal Logic Model Checker to edit faulty video frames. TSG and NeuS-E offer tradeoffs as TSG does not require access to a VLM or Image Editing model, while NeuS-E can be applied to black-box models. MinT ( Wu et al., 2025 ) learns temporal control by fine-tuning a video diffusion transformer on temporally grounded data. TSG operates at test-time with frozen parameters and no additional training data.
paragraphs.zh: 可控视频生成的方法主要在控制面和控制时机（采样期间或采样之后）上有所不同。 控制面包括时空场景布局（Lian et al., 2024；Qu et al., 2026），以及使用参考视频的动作迁移（Ling et al., 2024），它们与 TSG 专注于帧级视觉概念上的时间约束形成互补。 与我们工作最接近的是 TempoControl（Schiber et al., 2026），它通过在采样过程中反复优化视频潜变量，将概念注意力轨迹与规定的二值时间掩码对齐。 TSG 提供了对更具表达力的时间约束的控制，并且在严格定时的轨迹上以更低的计算开销优于 TempoControl（表 2）。 采样后的时间控制方法包括 NeuS-E（Choi et al., 2025），它使用视觉语言模型（VLM）来检测视觉概念，并利用时序逻辑模型检测器的反馈来编辑有缺陷的视频帧。 TSG 与 NeuS-E 各有取舍：TSG 不需要访问 VLM 或图像编辑模型，而 NeuS-E 可以应用于黑盒模型。 MinT（Wu et al., 2025）通过在时间对齐的数据上微调视频扩散 Transformer 来学习时间控制。 TSG 在测试时运行，参数冻结，且不需要额外的训练数据。

paragraphs.en: Attention provides both a signal of concept grounding and a mechanism for controlling generation of text ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Guardieiro et al., 2025 ) , and images ( Hertz et al., 2022 ; Chefer et al., 2023 ) . VideoTetris ( Tian et al., 2024 ) composes attention maps across space and time to control spatial positions of concepts. TSG supports richer temporal compositions beyond transitions but does not directly support control of spatial positions.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力既提供了概念落地的信号，也提供了控制文本生成的机制（Zhang et al., 2024; Guardieiro et al., 2025），以及控制图像生成的机制（Hertz et al., 2022; Chefer et al., 2023）。 VideoTetris（Tian et al., 2024）通过在空间和时间上组合注意力图来控制概念的空间位置。 TSG 支持比过渡更丰富的时间组合，但不直接支持对空间位置的控制。

sents.en: Attention provides both a signal of concept grounding and a mechanism for controlling generation of text ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Guardieiro et al., 2025 ) , and images ( Hertz et al., 2022 ; Chefer et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 注意力既提供了概念落地的信号，也提供了控制文本生成的机制（Zhang et al., 2024; Guardieiro et al., 2025），以及控制图像生成的机制（Hertz et al., 2022; Chefer et al., 2023）。

sents.en: VideoTetris ( Tian et al., 2024 ) composes attention maps across space and time to control spatial positions of concepts.
sents.zh: VideoTetris（Tian et al., 2024）通过在空间和时间上组合注意力图来控制概念的空间位置。

paragraphs.en: VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) assesses visual quality, temporal consistency, and semantic alignment, while T2V-CompBench ( Sun et al., 2025 ) evaluates compositional capabilities such as attribute binding, spatial relationships, actions, and motion. These broader evaluations remain complementary to specification satisfaction. TC-Bench ( Feng et al., 2024 ) and NeuS-V ( Sharan et al., 2025 ) evaluate untimed state transitions and temporal relationships, while TempoControl ( Schiber et al., 2026 ) tests exact timing of object appearance. These temporal constraints complement the interval-timed constraints in our benchmark. Our benchmark additionally evaluates alternate outcomes through choice, not supported by any prior benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: VBench（Huang et al., 2024）评估视觉质量、时间一致性和语义对齐，而 T2V-CompBench（Sun et al., 2025）评估属性绑定、空间关系、动作和运动等组合能力。 这些更广泛的评估与规约满足性的评估仍然是互补的。 TC-Bench（Feng et al., 2024）和 NeuS-V（Sharan et al., 2025）评估不带时间限制的状态转移和时间关系，而 TempoControl（Schiber et al., 2026）测试物体出现的确切时间。 这些时间约束与我们基准中的区间计时约束形成互补。 我们的基准还通过选择来评估替代结果，这是任何先前基准都不支持的能力。

sents.zh: TC-Bench（Feng et al., 2024）和 NeuS-V（Sharan et al., 2025）评估不带时间限制的状态转移和时间关系，而 TempoControl（Schiber et al., 2026）测试物体出现的确切时间。

sents.en: These temporal constraints complement the interval-timed constraints in our benchmark.
sents.zh: 这些时间约束与我们基准中的区间计时约束形成互补。

sents.en: Our benchmark additionally evaluates alternate outcomes through choice, not supported by any prior benchmark.
sents.zh: 我们的基准还通过选择来评估替代结果，这是任何先前基准都不支持的能力。

paragraphs.en: We present Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG), a training-free framework that turns temporal specifications into executable objectives for guiding video generation during sampling. We instantiate TSG with attention-derived concept traces, differentiable Metric Temporal Logic scores, and attention interventions that avoid backpropagation through the video transformer. This instantiation improves specification adherence across five models on a 220-prompt benchmark spanning 11 categories and achieves comparable temporal accuracy to TempoControl at lower computational cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出时序规约引导（Temporal Specification Guidance, TSG），这是一个无需训练的框架，它将时序规约转化为可执行的目标，用于在采样过程中引导视频生成。 我们通过注意力衍生的概念轨迹、可微分的度量时序逻辑（MTL）分数，以及避免对视频 Transformer 进行反向传播的注意力干预来实例化 TSG。 该实例化在涵盖 11 个类别的 220 条提示词基准上提升了五个模型的规约遵循度，并以更低的计算成本实现了与 TempoControl 相当的时序准确性。

sents.en: We present Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG), a training-free framework that turns temporal specifications into executable objectives for guiding video generation during sampling.
sents.zh: 我们提出时序规约引导（Temporal Specification Guidance, TSG），这是一个无需训练的框架，它将时序规约转化为可执行的目标，用于在采样过程中引导视频生成。

sents.en: We instantiate TSG with attention-derived concept traces, differentiable Metric Temporal Logic scores, and attention interventions that avoid backpropagation through the video transformer.

sents.en: This instantiation improves specification adherence across five models on a 220-prompt benchmark spanning 11 categories and achieves comparable temporal accuracy to TempoControl at lower computational cost.
sents.zh: 该实例化在涵盖 11 个类别的 220 条提示词基准上提升了五个模型的规约遵循度，并以更低的计算成本实现了与 TempoControl 相当的时序准确性。

paragraphs.en: Future work should explore traces of concept evidence beyond video-text attention maps, along with other scoring functions. TSG is limited to the latent temporal resolution of models and extending it to finer-grained temporal constraints is an interesting direction, along with identifying richer specification languages to express temporal requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作应探索视频-文本注意力图之外的概念证据痕迹，以及其他评分函数。 TSG 受限于模型的潜在时间分辨率，将其扩展到更细粒度的时间约束是一个有趣的方向，同时识别更丰富的规范语言来表达时间需求也值得研究。

paragraphs.en: We define a differentiable sum–product score for the fragment of M ​ T ​ L f MTL_{f} in Section 2 . paragraphs.en: The order of combination is essential because the Until operation is not commutative. Each value enters the back stack once, transfers to the front stack at most once, and leaves the queue at most once. Push and aggregate operations have constant cost; removal has amortized constant cost. No inverse operation is needed, so zero child scores and empty windows are handled directly.

paragraphs.en: Always uses addition of log scores with identity zero; Eventually uses log-add-exp with identity − ∞ -\infty . Until uses one window computation for the prefix log product and one for the log-domain block summaries. Lemma B.1 and Equation 9 show that their combination equals Equation 5 , including empty windows. Constants, literals, Boolean operators, and Next take O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) work by pointwise evaluation. Processing subformulas in postorder proves correctness by induction and evaluates each distinct subformula once, giving O ⁡ ( | φ | ​ N ) O(|\varphi|N) total work. Cached score arrays require O ⁡ ( | φ | ​ N ) O(|\varphi|N) storage, and the working arrays and aggregate queues require O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) additional space per subformula. The argument depends only on the number of subformulas, not on their nesting depth. ∎

At differentiable inputs, reverse-mode differentiation can therefore use the same asymptotic time and storage bounds, with structurally zero branches handled as constants. This is an arithmetic complexity statement; it does not establish a wall-clock speedup over a vectorized quadratic implementation on a GPU.

paragraphs.en: The mathematical definition admits exact zeros and ones. For numerical gradients, literal inputs can be clipped to [ ϵ LS , 1 − ϵ LS ] [\epsilon_{\mathrm{LS}},1-\epsilon_{\mathrm{LS}}] , separately from the calibration in Equation 2 . Composite scores are not clipped to one, and negation is applied only to atoms. Products are computed as sums of logarithms, and sums as log-sum-exp reductions. Empty products are one and empty sums are zero: Always on an empty window has log score zero, while Eventually and Until have log score − ∞ -\infty . On the domain where Q φ ​ [ 1 ] > 0 Q_{\varphi}[1]>0 , the log score is differentiable for literal inputs strictly between zero and one. Structurally zero branches, including log-add-exp with two constant − ∞ -\infty inputs, should be handled explicitly when differentiating. If the entire score is identically zero, for example because a required witness window is empty, its logarithm provides no finite gradient; the specification must be checked for feasibility on the chosen grid, and that objective should not produce a steering update.

paragraphs.en: We proceed by structural induction on the formula, simultaneously for every starting frame. Constants are nonnegative constant polynomials, and literal scores are individual input variables. Conjunction and Always take finite products of child scores; disjunction and Eventually take finite sums. paragraphs.en: Algorithm 3 presents TSG with online attention steering. The guided steps are the first N tsg N_{\mathrm{tsg}} sampling updates, i.e., 𝒦 = { N − N tsg + 1 , … , N } \mathcal{K}=\{N-N_{\mathrm{tsg}}+1,\ldots,N\} . paragraphs.en: We first use GPT-5.6-Sol to propose 50 entities spanning object and setting classes, together with associated states or attributes, such as color and time of day. This collection includes object classes from VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , augmented with states. One author manually reviews the collection to exclude unfamiliar entities and implausible entity–state combinations. Visual concepts represent entity presence or an entity assuming a particular state. The final inventory contains 50 entries: 36 objects and 14 scenes or settings. Examples of object entities with states are presented in Table 4 and of setting entities with states in Table 5 .

paragraphs.en: We manually define 11 categories of temporal constraints covering state transitions, entity appearance and disappearance, and choice. Table 3 illustrates each category. For each category, one author collaborates with GPT-5.6-Sol to construct 20 prompts, reviewing them for relevance, diversity of entities and states, and realism. We specify temporal intervals using halves and thirds of the video duration, allowing meaningful time for each event in a five-second video.

paragraphs.en: In the state-transition templates, A , B , C A,B,C refer to states of the same subject or setting; in the entry, handover, and entity-choice templates they denote entity presence. E E denotes an anchor or trigger as indicated. Every category has 20 examples. Choice formulas use an ordinary disjunction between exclusive branch predicates : either branch is acceptable, but both alternatives cannot satisfy the same required frame. Placing the disjunction outside the final-region always operators selects one fixed branch throughout that region. The middle third is unconstrained by AFS steering and, apart from anchor persistence, by AEC steering; these formulas do not prohibit transient alternative states in that gap.
paragraphs.zh: 在状态转移模板中，A、B、C 指同一主体或场景的状态；在进入、交接与实体选择模板中，它们表示实体的存在。 E 按标注所示表示锚点或触发器。 每个类别有 20 个示例。 选择公式在互斥的分支谓词之间使用普通析取：任一分支都可接受，但两个备选项不能同时满足同一个必需的框架。 将析取置于最终区域的 always 算子之外，会在整个区域内固定选择一个分支。 中间三分之一不受 AFS 引导的约束，除锚点持续性外也不受 AEC 引导的约束；这些公式不禁止在该间隙中出现瞬时的替代状态。

paragraphs.en: “A cinematic, photorealistic 4K close-up follows one street traffic light at dusk from a fixed tripod camera. The signal is solid yellow for roughly the first third of the video. About one-third of the way through, that same signal changes cleanly to solid red. Around two-thirds of the way through, it changes to solid green and remains green through the end. The softly blurred urban background stays unchanged, with no camera movement, scene cuts, duplicate traffic lights, or extra signal flicker.”
paragraphs.zh: “一段电影感、照片级真实感的 4K 特写镜头，由固定在三脚架上的相机在黄昏时分跟随一个街道交通信号灯拍摄。 在视频大约前三分之一的时段里，信号灯保持纯黄色。 在视频进行到约三分之一处，同一信号灯干净利落地切换为纯红色。 在视频进行到约三分之二处，信号灯切换为纯绿色，并在剩余时间里一直保持绿色。 柔和虚化的城市背景保持不变，没有相机移动、场景切换、重复的交通信号灯或多余的信号闪烁。”

paragraphs.zh: 在一个连续的中景镜头的前半段左右，一个人独自在安静的公园空地上等待。 在中段左右，一只狗跑进空地并在附近停下。 直到结尾，同一个人和狗始终完整可见地同框，没有切换、没有重复主体，也没有镜头移动。

Explicit persistence requirements are evaluated over their stated intervals rather than reduced to a 0.5 0.5 -second witness. paragraphs.en: Interpretation of the criterion. We evaluate whether each required phase occurs within its designated interval and persists for at least 0.5 seconds. We intentionally leave the intervening transitions unconstrained: intermediate configurations may not map unambiguously to the discrete propositions. For example, a partially open door may be labeled either open or closed while it moves between states. Requiring a sustained witness for each phase establishes that the requested states occur in the specified temporal order without prescribing the duration or frame-by-frame labeling of the transition between them. This criterion does not require each phase to occupy its entire interval or restrict behavior outside the witness runs, except where the specification imposes explicit persistence or absence constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 判据的解释。 我们评估每个所需阶段是否发生在其指定区间内，并持续至少 0.5 秒。 我们有意不对中间的过渡施加约束：中间配置可能无法明确地映射到离散命题。 例如，一扇部分打开的门在状态之间移动时，可能被标记为开或闭中的任意一种。 要求每个阶段有一个持续存在的见证，即可确立所请求的状态按指定的时间顺序出现，而无需规定状态之间过渡的持续时间或逐帧标注。 除规约中施加了显式的持续或缺失约束之处外，该判据不要求每个阶段占据其整个区间，也不限制见证运行之外的行为。

paragraphs.en: The main TSG benchmark uses online attention steering with norm ratio ρ = 1 \rho=1 , applied during the first 15 denoising steps (indices 0–14). Ordinary CFG remains active throughout sampling. We set the additional weight to zero when the residual norm is at most 10 − 12 10^{-12} . We use the z-score–sigmoid calibration with temperature τ = 1.0 \tau=1.0 and denominator stabilizer ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon=10^{-6} , holding the temporal mean and standard deviation fixed during differentiation. After broadcasting and centering the attention-logit biases, we clip them to [ b min , b max ] = [ − 1.0 , 1.0 ] [b_{\min},b_{\max}]=[-1.0,1.0] . We use bias step size η = 1 \eta=1 . We steer all attention heads in all transformer layers: 30 layers for Wan 2.1, Wan 2.2 TI2V, and CogVideoX 2B; 40 per active expert for Wan 2.2 A14B; and 42 for CogVideoX 5B.

paragraphs.en: We use all 80 one-object and 82 two-object prompts from the official TempoControl benchmark repository. One-object prompts request an initially absent object that appears during the second, third, fourth, or last second and remains visible, with 20 prompts for each onset. Two-object prompts require a static object throughout, with another object appearing in the second half. Binary masks are derived from the requested timing and the actual video frame rate and duration, rather than reusing the original 21-bin masks at a different duration. For our five-second Wan clips, the four one-object onsets occur at sampled indices 4, 8, 12, and 16, respectively; the object must be absent before its onset and present from that index through index 20. Two-object masks require absence of the entering object at indices 0–9 and presence at indices 10–20, together with the static object throughout.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用官方 TempoControl 基准仓库中的全部 80 条单目标提示词和 82 条双目标提示词。 单目标提示词要求一个初始不存在的目标在第二、第三、第四或最后一秒出现并保持可见，每个出现时间点各对应 20 条提示词。 双目标提示词要求一个目标全程保持静止，另一个目标在后半段出现。 二值掩码由所要求的时间点以及实际视频帧率和时长推导得出，而不是在不同时长下复用原始的 21 桶掩码。 对于我们的五秒 Wan 片段，四个单目标出现时间点分别位于采样索引 4、8、12 和 16；目标必须在其出现时间点之前不存在，并从该索引起一直存在到索引 20。 双目标掩码要求进入的目标在索引 0–9 不存在、在索引 10–20 存在，同时静止目标全程存在。

The static-object requirement is a global always formula. The runtime steering grid with Wan2.1 1.3B has 21 latent frames. All four comparison methods, i.e., CFG-only, TempoControl, one-round TempoControl, and TSG, use Wan 2.1 at 480 × 832 480\times 832 , 81 frames, 16 FPS, 50 steps, CFG 6, and flow shift 3. paragraphs.en: Our TempoControl port preserves the released optimization order using the Diffusers backbone: latent optimization follows the scheduler update and queries attention at the preceding timestep. It optimizes the latent with AdamW (weight decay 0.01) at steps 0–10, with learning rate 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} for one-object and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for two-object prompts. The objective uses energy weight 0.3 and entropy weight 10, with query chunks of 512 positions and activation checkpointing for the attention forward pass. The full variant allows up to ten optimization updates per guided step, following official recommendations in the repository. Early stopping checks whether the first controlled concept’s Pearson correlation with its target mask exceeds 0.9, before applying the next update. The one-round variant changes only the maximum update count to one; it retains this early-stopping check and the same 11 guided steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 TempoControl 移植版本基于 Diffusers 骨干保留了已发布的优化顺序：潜变量优化跟随调度器更新，并在前一时间步查询注意力。 它在第 0–10 步使用 AdamW（权重衰减 0.01）优化潜变量，单物体提示的学习率为 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4}，双物体提示为 10 − 3 10^{-3}。 该目标使用能量权重 0.3 和熵权重 10，查询分块为 512 个位置，并对注意力前向传播使用激活检查点。 完整变体在每个引导步中最多允许十次优化更新，遵循代码库中的官方建议。 早停机制在应用下一次更新之前，检查第一个受控概念与其目标掩码的皮尔逊相关系数是否超过 0.9。 单轮变体仅将最大更新次数改为一，但保留该早停检查以及相同的 11 个引导步。

sents.en: Our TempoControl port preserves the released optimization order using the Diffusers backbone: latent optimization follows the scheduler update and queries attention at the preceding timestep.
sents.zh: 我们的 TempoControl 移植版本基于 Diffusers 骨干保留了已发布的优化顺序：潜变量优化跟随调度器更新，并在前一时间步查询注意力。

sents.en: It optimizes the latent with AdamW (weight decay 0.01) at steps 0–10, with learning rate 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} for one-object and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for two-object prompts.
sents.zh: 它在第 0–10 步使用 AdamW（权重衰减 0.01）优化潜变量，单物体提示的学习率为 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4}，双物体提示为 10 − 3 10^{-3}。

sents.en: The objective uses energy weight 0.3 and entropy weight 10, with query chunks of 512 positions and activation checkpointing for the attention forward pass.
sents.zh: 该目标使用能量权重 0.3 和熵权重 10，查询分块为 512 个位置，并对注意力前向传播使用激活检查点。

sents.en: The full variant allows up to ten optimization updates per guided step, following official recommendations in the repository.
sents.zh: 完整变体在每个引导步中最多允许十次优化更新，遵循代码库中的官方建议。

sents.en: Early stopping checks whether the first controlled concept’s Pearson correlation with its target mask exceeds 0.9, before applying the next update.
sents.zh: 早停机制在应用下一次更新之前，检查第一个受控概念与其目标掩码的皮尔逊相关系数是否超过 0.9。

sents.en: The one-round variant changes only the maximum update count to one; it retains this early-stopping check and the same 11 guided steps.
sents.zh: 单轮变体仅将最大更新次数改为一，但保留该早停检查以及相同的 11 个引导步。

paragraphs.en: The guidance-strength ablations in Section 6 compare Wan 2.1 and Wan 2.2 TI2V on the same 25 samples. Every configuration replays its model’s saved base latent tensor for each example. We retain the model-specific settings in Table 6 , all attention layers and heads, the first 15 guided steps, step size 1, and the calibration and clipping settings above. The additional strengths are ρ ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } \rho\in\{2,3,4,5\} , compared with the existing base and ρ = 1 \rho=1 runs. Only ρ \rho changes within this sweep.

sents.en: The guidance-strength ablations in Section 6 compare Wan 2.1 and Wan 2.2 TI2V on the same 25 samples.
sents.zh: 第 6 节中的引导强度消融实验在相同的 25 个样本上比较 Wan 2.1 与 Wan 2.2 TI2V。

sents.en: We retain the model-specific settings in Table 6 , all attention layers and heads, the first 15 guided steps, step size 1, and the calibration and clipping settings above.
sents.zh: 我们保留表 6 中特定于模型的设置、所有注意力层与头、前 15 个引导步骤、步长 1，以及上述校准与裁剪设置。

sents.en: The additional strengths are ρ ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } \rho\in\{2,3,4,5\} , compared with the existing base and ρ = 1 \rho=1 runs.
sents.zh: 相较于已有的基础运行和 ρ = 1 \rho=1 的运行，新增的强度为 ρ ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } \rho\in\{2,3,4,5\}。

paragraphs.en: The CFG interaction ablations also use the same base settings but modify the sampling as required. For the double strength CFG runs, we double the CFG strengths in Table 6 for Wan2.1 and Wan2.2 5B. For TSG-only, we run TSG for all 50 steps and replace the conditional directions in CFG’s update with the TSG predicted specification-guided direction (CFG’s guidance scale is used).
paragraphs.zh: CFG 交互消融实验同样使用相同的基础设置，但根据需要对采样进行修改。 对于双强度 CFG 运行，我们将表 6 中 Wan2.1 和 Wan2.2 5B 的 CFG 强度加倍。 对于仅 TSG 的设置，我们在全部 50 步中运行 TSG，并将 CFG 更新中的条件方向替换为 TSG 预测的规范引导方向（使用 CFG 的引导 scale）。

sents.en: The CFG interaction ablations also use the same base settings but modify the sampling as required.
sents.zh: CFG 交互消融实验同样使用相同的基础设置，但根据需要对采样进行修改。

sents.en: For the double strength CFG runs, we double the CFG strengths in Table 6 for Wan2.1 and Wan2.2 5B.
sents.zh: 对于双强度 CFG 运行，我们将表 6 中 Wan2.1 和 Wan2.2 5B 的 CFG 强度加倍。

sents.en: For TSG-only, we run TSG for all 50 steps and replace the conditional directions in CFG’s update with the TSG predicted specification-guided direction (CFG’s guidance scale is used).
sents.zh: 对于仅 TSG 的设置，我们在全部 50 步中运行 TSG，并将 CFG 更新中的条件方向替换为 TSG 预测的规范引导方向（使用 CFG 的引导 scale）。

paragraphs.en: Wan 2.1, Wan 2.2 TI2V, both CogVideoX models, and the TempoControl comparison are run on a cluster with NVIDIA B200 GPUs. The Wan 2.2 A14B model is run on a cluster with NVIDIA H200s. The models use bfloat16 except CogVideoX 2B, which uses float16; the VAE uses float32. The recorded runtime is PyTorch 2.9.1 with CUDA 12.8, Diffusers 0.36.0, and Transformers 4.57.3. CogVideoX enables VAE tiling and slicing. The attention implementation uses PyTorch scaled-dot-product attention for ordinary computation and explicit attention-score computation where needed for capture and steering; the exact kernel selected by the runtime is not recorded in the per-video profiles.
paragraphs.zh: Wan 2.1、Wan 2.2 TI2V、两个 CogVideoX 模型以及 TempoControl 对比实验均在配备 NVIDIA B200 GPU 的集群上运行。 Wan 2.2 A14B 模型在配备 NVIDIA H200 的集群上运行。 除使用 float16 的 CogVideoX 2B 外，各模型均使用 bfloat16；VAE 使用 float32。 所记录的运行环境为 PyTorch 2.9.1（CUDA 12.8）、Diffusers 0.36.0 和 Transformers 4.57.3。 CogVideoX 启用了 VAE 分块与切片。 注意力实现在常规计算中使用 PyTorch 缩放点积注意力，在为捕获与引导所需的场合使用显式注意力分数计算；运行时所选择的确切算子内核未记录在逐视频的剖析文件中。

sents.en: Wan 2.1, Wan 2.2 TI2V, both CogVideoX models, and the TempoControl comparison are run on a cluster with NVIDIA B200 GPUs.
sents.zh: Wan 2.1、Wan 2.2 TI2V、两个 CogVideoX 模型以及 TempoControl 对比实验均在配备 NVIDIA B200 GPU 的集群上运行。

sents.en: The Wan 2.2 A14B model is run on a cluster with NVIDIA H200s.
sents.zh: Wan 2.2 A14B 模型在配备 NVIDIA H200 的集群上运行。

sents.en: The models use bfloat16 except CogVideoX 2B, which uses float16; the VAE uses float32.
sents.zh: 除使用 float16 的 CogVideoX 2B 外，各模型均使用 bfloat16；VAE 使用 float32。

sents.en: The recorded runtime is PyTorch 2.9.1 with CUDA 12.8, Diffusers 0.36.0, and Transformers 4.57.3.
sents.zh: 所记录的运行环境为 PyTorch 2.9.1（CUDA 12.8）、Diffusers 0.36.0 和 Transformers 4.57.3。

sents.en: CogVideoX enables VAE tiling and slicing.
sents.zh: CogVideoX 启用了 VAE 分块与切片。

sents.en: The attention implementation uses PyTorch scaled-dot-product attention for ordinary computation and explicit attention-score computation where needed for capture and steering; the exact kernel selected by the runtime is not recorded in the per-video profiles.
sents.zh: 注意力实现在常规计算中使用 PyTorch 缩放点积注意力，在为捕获与引导所需的场合使用显式注意力分数计算；运行时所选择的确切算子内核未记录在逐视频的剖析文件中。

paragraphs.en: Timing uses a monotonic clock with CUDA synchronization at measurement boundaries. Before each measured video, the profiler empties the CUDA allocator cache and resets peak-memory statistics after model loading. There is no separate discarded warm-up video in this measurement procedure. Generation latency includes initial-noise preparation or replay, prompt encoding, denoising and guidance, and VAE decoding. It excludes model loading, video export, evaluation, and separately timed diagnostic artifacts. Diagnostic memory allocations can still contribute to the recorded peak. When reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation, the standard deviation is the sample standard deviation across videos, not a confidence interval or variation over repeated seeds. Peak memory is the maximum of the per-video PyTorch allocated-memory peaks, including resident model weights, converted to GiB; it is not device-wide memory usage or allocator-reserved memory. Hardware differs for A14B, so cross-model latency comparisons also reflect that difference.
paragraphs.zh: 计时使用单调时钟，并在测量边界处进行 CUDA 同步。 在每段被测视频之前，性能分析器会清空 CUDA 分配器缓存，并在模型加载后重置峰值内存统计。 该测量流程中没有单独丢弃的预热视频。 生成延迟包括初始噪声的准备或重放、提示词编码、去噪与引导，以及 VAE 解码。 它不包括模型加载、视频导出、评估以及单独计时的诊断性产物。 诊断性的内存分配仍可能计入记录的峰值。 当报告为均值 ± \pm 标准差时，该标准差是跨视频的样本标准差，而不是置信区间或多次随机种子间的变异。 峰值内存是每段视频的 PyTorch 已分配内存峰值中的最大值，包括常驻模型权重，并换算为 GiB；它不是设备级内存占用，也不是分配器保留的内存。 A14B 所用的硬件不同，因此跨模型的延迟比较也反映了这一差异。

sents.en: Timing uses a monotonic clock with CUDA synchronization at measurement boundaries.
sents.zh: 计时使用单调时钟，并在测量边界处进行 CUDA 同步。

sents.en: Before each measured video, the profiler empties the CUDA allocator cache and resets peak-memory statistics after model loading.
sents.zh: 在每段被测视频之前，性能分析器会清空 CUDA 分配器缓存，并在模型加载后重置峰值内存统计。

sents.en: There is no separate discarded warm-up video in this measurement procedure.
sents.zh: 该测量流程中没有单独丢弃的预热视频。

sents.en: Generation latency includes initial-noise preparation or replay, prompt encoding, denoising and guidance, and VAE decoding.
sents.zh: 生成延迟包括初始噪声的准备或重放、提示词编码、去噪与引导，以及 VAE 解码。

sents.en: It excludes model loading, video export, evaluation, and separately timed diagnostic artifacts.
sents.zh: 它不包括模型加载、视频导出、评估以及单独计时的诊断性产物。

sents.en: Diagnostic memory allocations can still contribute to the recorded peak.
sents.zh: 诊断性的内存分配仍可能计入记录的峰值。

sents.en: When reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation, the standard deviation is the sample standard deviation across videos, not a confidence interval or variation over repeated seeds.
sents.zh: 当报告为均值 ± \pm 标准差时，该标准差是跨视频的样本标准差，而不是置信区间或多次随机种子间的变异。

sents.en: Peak memory is the maximum of the per-video PyTorch allocated-memory peaks, including resident model weights, converted to GiB; it is not device-wide memory usage or allocator-reserved memory.
sents.zh: 峰值内存是每段视频的 PyTorch 已分配内存峰值中的最大值，包括常驻模型权重，并换算为 GiB；它不是设备级内存占用，也不是分配器保留的内存。

sents.en: Hardware differs for A14B, so cross-model latency comparisons also reflect that difference.
sents.zh: A14B 所用的硬件不同，因此跨模型的延迟比较也反映了这一差异。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 21 uniformly spaced decoded frames for every model, including the first and last frame. For a video with F F frames, sampled index i i is ⌊ i ⁡ ( F − 1 ) / 20 ⌋ \lfloor i(F-1)/20\rfloor , for i = 0 , … , 20 i=0,\ldots,20 . We extract binary concept traces using Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct . Specification satisfaction accuracy (Sat Acc.) evaluates the prompt-derived specification under the Boolean semantics from Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个模型评估 21 个均匀间隔的解码帧，包括第一帧和最后一帧。 对于具有 F F 帧的视频，采样索引 i i 为 ⌊ i ⁡ ( F − 1 ) / 20 ⌋ \lfloor i(F-1)/20\rfloor ，其中 i = 0 , … , 20 i=0,\ldots,20 。 我们使用 Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 提取二值概念轨迹。 规格满足准确率（Sat Acc.）基于附录 A 中的布尔语义来评估由提示词导出的规格。

sents.en: We evaluate 21 uniformly spaced decoded frames for every model, including the first and last frame.
sents.zh: 我们对每个模型评估 21 个均匀间隔的解码帧，包括第一帧和最后一帧。

sents.en: For a video with F F frames, sampled index i i is ⌊ i ⁡ ( F − 1 ) / 20 ⌋ \lfloor i(F-1)/20\rfloor , for i = 0 , … , 20 i=0,\ldots,20 .
sents.zh: 对于具有 F F 帧的视频，采样索引 i i 为 ⌊ i ⁡ ( F − 1 ) / 20 ⌋ \lfloor i(F-1)/20\rfloor ，其中 i = 0 , … , 20 i=0,\ldots,20 。

sents.en: We extract binary concept traces using Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct .
sents.zh: 我们使用 Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 提取二值概念轨迹。

sents.en: Specification satisfaction accuracy (Sat Acc.) evaluates the prompt-derived specification under the Boolean semantics from Appendix A .
sents.zh: 规格满足准确率（Sat Acc.）基于附录 A 中的布尔语义来评估由提示词导出的规格。

paragraphs.en: We use the MUSIQ-SPAQ model underlying VBench’s imaging-quality dimension ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . It scores the same sampled frames used for specification evaluation, resizing the longer side to at most 512 pixels according to the VBench preprocessing. We average over frames within each video and then over videos. The table reports raw MUSIQ units, with larger values indicating better perceptual frame quality. Latency and peak GPU memory follow the measurement definitions above.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用支撑 VBench 成像质量维度的 MUSIQ-SPAQ 模型（Huang et al., 2024）。 它对与规格评估相同的采样帧进行打分，并按照 VBench 的预处理方式将较长边缩放至至多 512 像素。 我们先对每个视频内的帧取平均，再对各视频取平均。 表中报告的是原始 MUSIQ 单位，数值越大表示感知帧质量越好。 延迟与峰值 GPU 显存遵循上文中的测量定义。

sents.en: We use the MUSIQ-SPAQ model underlying VBench’s imaging-quality dimension ( Huang et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用支撑 VBench 成像质量维度的 MUSIQ-SPAQ 模型（Huang et al., 2024）。

sents.en: It scores the same sampled frames used for specification evaluation, resizing the longer side to at most 512 pixels according to the VBench preprocessing.
sents.zh: 它对与规格评估相同的采样帧进行打分，并按照 VBench 的预处理方式将较长边缩放至至多 512 像素。

sents.en: We average over frames within each video and then over videos.
sents.zh: 我们先对每个视频内的帧取平均，再对各视频取平均。

sents.en: The table reports raw MUSIQ units, with larger values indicating better perceptual frame quality.
sents.zh: 表中报告的是原始 MUSIQ 单位，数值越大表示感知帧质量越好。

sents.en: Latency and peak GPU memory follow the measurement definitions above.
sents.zh: 延迟与峰值 GPU 显存遵循上文中的测量定义。

paragraphs.en: The Qwen evaluator makes one request per sampled frame, asking for all relevant propositions together. The frame is converted to a uint8 PIL image and passed through the model’s image processor and chat template. The application sends one user message containing the image and the verification prompt. Decoding is greedy, with at most 256 new tokens and one frame per request. The evaluator sees proposition definitions but not the requested temporal schedule or neighboring frames.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen 评估器对每个采样帧发起一次请求，一次性询问所有相关的命题。 帧被转换为 uint8 类型的 PIL 图像，并经过模型的图像处理器和聊天模板处理。 应用程序发送一条包含图像和验证提示词的用户消息。 解码采用贪心策略，每次请求最多生成 256 个新 token，且每次只处理一帧。 评估器能看到命题定义，但看不到所要求的时间安排或相邻帧。

sents.en: The Qwen evaluator makes one request per sampled frame, asking for all relevant propositions together.
sents.zh: Qwen 评估器对每个采样帧发起一次请求，一次性询问所有相关的命题。

sents.en: The frame is converted to a uint8 PIL image and passed through the model’s image processor and chat template.
sents.zh: 帧被转换为 uint8 类型的 PIL 图像，并经过模型的图像处理器和聊天模板处理。

sents.en: The application sends one user message containing the image and the verification prompt.
sents.zh: 应用程序发送一条包含图像和验证提示词的用户消息。

sents.en: Decoding is greedy, with at most 256 new tokens and one frame per request.
sents.zh: 解码采用贪心策略，每次请求最多生成 256 个新 token，且每次只处理一帧。

sents.en: The evaluator sees proposition definitions but not the requested temporal schedule or neighboring frames.
sents.zh: 评估器能看到命题定义，但看不到所要求的时间安排或相邻帧。

paragraphs.en: The fixed user-prompt preamble is reproduced below; the schema-specific field definitions are then appended from each example’s proposition contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 固定的用户提示词前导部分复现如下；随后从每个示例的命题上下文中追加特定于模式（schema）的字段定义。

paragraphs.en: Inspect only the supplied frame. Report what is visibly supported, not what ought to happen. The scene may be stylized or synthetic. Do not infer missing objects or a desired temporal phase. Return only one JSON object with exactly the keys described below, without explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 仅检查所提供的帧。 报告有可见依据的内容，而不是本应发生的内容。 场景可能是风格化的或合成的。 不要推断缺失的物体或期望的时间阶段。 仅返回一个 JSON 对象，且必须恰好包含下述键，不要附带任何解释。

sents.en: Inspect only the supplied frame.
sents.zh: 仅检查所提供的帧。

sents.en: Report what is visibly supported, not what ought to happen.
sents.zh: 报告有可见依据的内容，而不是本应发生的内容。

sents.en: The scene may be stylized or synthetic.
sents.zh: 场景可能是风格化的或合成的。

sents.en: Do not infer missing objects or a desired temporal phase.
sents.zh: 不要推断缺失的物体或期望的时间阶段。

sents.en: Return only one JSON object with exactly the keys described below, without explanations.
sents.zh: 仅返回一个 JSON 对象，且必须恰好包含下述键，不要附带任何解释。

paragraphs.en: Object-presence fields: “present” means any recognizable visible part, even at the edge, small, or partially occluded. “absent” means confidently not visible. “unclear” means the evidence cannot establish presence or absence; do not equate uncertainty with absence.
paragraphs.zh: 对象存在性字段：“present”意味着任何可辨认的可见部分，即使是在边缘、很小或部分被遮挡的情况。“absent”意味着确定不可见。“unclear”意味着证据无法确定存在或不存在；不要将不确定性等同于不存在。

paragraphs.en: State fields: return a JSON list of the exact state names visibly supported. Normally one state applies. If multiple states visibly coexist, list all of them; do not force a valid phase. Return [] only when you can confidently establish that none applies. Return [“unclear”] if the state cannot be determined, the transition is ambiguous, or the relevant entity is not recognizable. Do not combine “unclear” with other labels. Use the same visible entity when distinguishing its states. A closed door is shut; an open or ajar door is not closed. If the opening cannot be seen clearly, use unclear. Standing and sitting refer to the actual pose; an ambiguous intermediate pose is unclear. For traffic lights, judge the illuminated signal, not an unlit colored lens.
paragraphs.zh: 状态字段：返回一个 JSON 列表，列出可见支持的准确状态名称。 通常只有一个状态适用。 如果多个状态明显共存，列出所有状态；不要强行归入有效阶段。 只有在你能确信没有任何状态适用时才返回 []。 如果无法确定状态、状态转换不明确，或相关实体无法辨认，则返回 [“unclear”]。 不要将 “unclear” 与其他标签组合使用。 在区分同一实体的状态时，应使用同一可见实体。 关闭的门是 shut；打开或半开的门不是 closed。 如果开口无法看清，使用 unclear。 站立和坐姿指实际姿态；模糊的中间姿态为 unclear。 对于红绿灯，应判断点亮的信号，而不是未点亮的彩色灯镜。

sents.en: State fields: return a JSON list of the exact state names visibly supported.
sents.zh: 状态字段：返回一个 JSON 列表，列出可见支持的准确状态名称。

sents.en: Normally one state applies.
sents.zh: 通常只有一个状态适用。

sents.en: If multiple states visibly coexist, list all of them; do not force a valid phase.
sents.zh: 如果多个状态明显共存，列出所有状态；不要强行归入有效阶段。

sents.en: Return [] only when you can confidently establish that none applies.
sents.zh: 只有在你能确信没有任何状态适用时才返回 []。

sents.en: Return [“unclear”] if the state cannot be determined, the transition is ambiguous, or the relevant entity is not recognizable.
sents.zh: 如果无法确定状态、状态转换不明确，或相关实体无法辨认，则返回 [“unclear”]。

sents.en: Do not combine “unclear” with other labels.
sents.zh: 不要将 “unclear” 与其他标签组合使用。

sents.en: Use the same visible entity when distinguishing its states.
sents.zh: 在区分同一实体的状态时，应使用同一可见实体。

sents.en: A closed door is shut; an open or ajar door is not closed.
sents.zh: 关闭的门是 shut；打开或半开的门不是 closed。

sents.en: If the opening cannot be seen clearly, use unclear.
sents.zh: 如果开口无法看清，使用 unclear。

sents.en: Standing and sitting refer to the actual pose; an ambiguous intermediate pose is unclear.
sents.zh: 站立和坐姿指实际姿态；模糊的中间姿态为 unclear。

sents.en: For traffic lights, judge the illuminated signal, not an unlit colored lens.
sents.zh: 对于红绿灯，应判断点亮的信号，而不是未点亮的彩色灯镜。

paragraphs.en: For example, a pose-transition request appends a state field listing the allowed compound state labels and their definitions. Entity-presence fields instead allow present , absent , or unclear . City-lighting alternatives additionally receive explicit daytime, sunset, and nighttime definitions.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，姿态转换请求会附加一个状态字段，列出允许的复合状态标签及其定义。 实体存在字段则允许取值为「存在」「不存在」或「不明确」。 城市照明备选方案还额外获得了白天、日落和夜间的明确定义。

sents.en: For example, a pose-transition request appends a state field listing the allowed compound state labels and their definitions.
sents.zh: 例如，姿态转换请求会附加一个状态字段，列出允许的复合状态标签及其定义。

sents.en: Entity-presence fields instead allow present , absent , or unclear .
sents.zh: 实体存在字段则允许取值为「存在」「不存在」或「不明确」。

sents.en: City-lighting alternatives additionally receive explicit daytime, sunset, and nighttime definitions.
sents.zh: 城市照明备选方案还额外获得了白天、日落和夜间的明确定义。

paragraphs.en: Parsing accepts a JSON object, optionally within a JSON code fence, and normalizes case, whitespace, underscores, and Unicode dash separators in labels. Multiple supported states may be returned simultaneously; we do not force the answer to match a valid temporal phase. Explicit unclear labels and omitted fields map to false in the binary trace. Unknown fields are ignored; invalid known fields, unknown state labels, and inconsistent aliases raise protocol errors. The current evaluator allows two schema-correction retries on the same frame and preserves the invalid responses; exhausted retries leave an error record rather than a fabricated verdict. Earlier saved evaluations without retries remain identified by their raw-response records and source snapshots.
paragraphs.zh: 解析接受一个 JSON 对象（可以包在 JSON 代码围栏内），并对标签中的大小写、空白、下划线和 Unicode 连字符分隔符进行规范化。 多个受支持的状态可以同时返回；我们不强制答案必须匹配某个有效的时间阶段。 显式的不明确标签和省略的字段在二进制轨迹中映射为 false。 未知字段会被忽略；无效的已知字段、未知的状态标签以及不一致的别名会引发协议错误。 当前评估器允许对同一帧进行两次模式纠正重试并保留无效响应；重试耗尽后留下一条错误记录，而不是捏造的判定。 没有重试的早期已保存评估仍通过其原始响应记录和来源快照来标识。

sents.en: Parsing accepts a JSON object, optionally within a JSON code fence, and normalizes case, whitespace, underscores, and Unicode dash separators in labels.
sents.zh: 解析接受一个 JSON 对象（可以包在 JSON 代码围栏内），并对标签中的大小写、空白、下划线和 Unicode 连字符分隔符进行规范化。

sents.en: Multiple supported states may be returned simultaneously; we do not force the answer to match a valid temporal phase.
sents.zh: 多个受支持的状态可以同时返回；我们不强制答案必须匹配某个有效的时间阶段。

sents.en: Explicit unclear labels and omitted fields map to false in the binary trace.
sents.zh: 显式的不明确标签和省略的字段在二进制轨迹中映射为 false。

sents.en: Unknown fields are ignored; invalid known fields, unknown state labels, and inconsistent aliases raise protocol errors.
sents.zh: 未知字段会被忽略；无效的已知字段、未知的状态标签以及不一致的别名会引发协议错误。

sents.en: The current evaluator allows two schema-correction retries on the same frame and preserves the invalid responses; exhausted retries leave an error record rather than a fabricated verdict.
sents.zh: 当前评估器允许对同一帧进行两次模式纠正重试并保留无效响应；重试耗尽后留下一条错误记录，而不是捏造的判定。

sents.en: Earlier saved evaluations without retries remain identified by their raw-response records and source snapshots.
sents.zh: 没有重试的早期已保存评估仍通过其原始响应记录和来源快照来标识。

paragraphs.en: Across all five models, Qwen returned “unclear” labels for at least one proposition in 433 of 46,200 individual frames (0.94%). We assessed sensitivity to these labels using conservative and optimistic treatments across all five models. Conservatively, unclear labels support neither positive nor negative literals; no currently passing video fails under this treatment , leaving reported accuracies unchanged. Optimistically, unclear labels may take Boolean values that satisfy the specification. With models weighted equally, this increases CFG accuracy by 0.73 0.73 percentage points and TSG accuracy by 1.36 1.36 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: 在全部五个模型中，Qwen 在 46,200 个单独帧中的 433 帧（0.94%）对至少一个命题返回了「不明确」标签。 我们使用保守和乐观两种处理方式，在全部五个模型上评估了对这些标签的敏感性。 保守地看，不明确标签既不支持正向字面量也不支持负向字面量；目前没有通过测试的视频在这种处理方式下失败，因此报告的准确率保持不变。 乐观地看，不明确标签可以取满足规范的布尔值。 在各模型等权的情况下，这使 CFG 准确率提高 0.73 个百分点，使 TSG 准确率提高 1.36 个百分点。

sents.en: Across all five models, Qwen returned “unclear” labels for at least one proposition in 433 of 46,200 individual frames (0.94%).
sents.zh: 在全部五个模型中，Qwen 在 46,200 个单独帧中的 433 帧（0.94%）对至少一个命题返回了「不明确」标签。

sents.en: We assessed sensitivity to these labels using conservative and optimistic treatments across all five models.
sents.zh: 我们使用保守和乐观两种处理方式，在全部五个模型上评估了对这些标签的敏感性。

sents.en: Conservatively, unclear labels support neither positive nor negative literals; no currently passing video fails under this treatment , leaving reported accuracies unchanged.
sents.zh: 保守地看，不明确标签既不支持正向字面量也不支持负向字面量；目前没有通过测试的视频在这种处理方式下失败，因此报告的准确率保持不变。

sents.en: Optimistically, unclear labels may take Boolean values that satisfy the specification.
sents.zh: 乐观地看，不明确标签可以取满足规范的布尔值。

sents.en: With models weighted equally, this increases CFG accuracy by 0.73 0.73 percentage points and TSG accuracy by 1.36 1.36 percentage points.
sents.zh: 在各模型等权的情况下，这使 CFG 准确率提高 0.73 个百分点，使 TSG 准确率提高 1.36 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Object evaluation uses the YOLOv10x detector with Ultralytics 8.4.152 on 21 sampled frames. The detector is invoked with its prediction defaults. Detected class names and requested labels are compared literally after lowercasing.
paragraphs.zh: 目标评估使用在 21 帧采样帧上以 Ultralytics 8.4.152 运行的 YOLOv10x 检测器。 该检测器以其预测默认参数被调用。 检测到的类别名称与请求的标签在转为小写后进行字面比较。

sents.en: Object evaluation uses the YOLOv10x detector with Ultralytics 8.4.152 on 21 sampled frames.
sents.zh: 目标评估使用在 21 帧采样帧上以 Ultralytics 8.4.152 运行的 YOLOv10x 检测器。

sents.en: The detector is invoked with its prediction defaults.
sents.zh: 该检测器以其预测默认参数被调用。

sents.en: Detected class names and requested labels are compared literally after lowercasing.
sents.zh: 检测到的类别名称与请求的标签在转为小写后进行字面比较。

paragraphs.en: For one-object clips, a sampled frame is correct if detected presence matches the target mask. For two-object clips, correctness additionally requires the static object in both phases: before entry, the static object must be detected and the entering object absent; after entry, both must be detected. Temporal accuracy is the mean per-video fraction of correct frames. This frame-wise metric differs from the whole-video specification accuracy used on the TSG benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 对于单目标片段，若检测到的存在性与目标掩码一致，则采样的帧判定为正确。 对于双目标片段，正确性还额外要求两个阶段的静态目标：进入前，静态目标必须被检测到且进入目标不存在；进入后，两者都必须被检测到。 时间准确性是每个视频中正确帧比例的均值。 这种逐帧指标不同于在 TSG 基准上使用的整段视频规范准确性。

sents.en: For one-object clips, a sampled frame is correct if detected presence matches the target mask.
sents.zh: 对于单目标片段，若检测到的存在性与目标掩码一致，则采样的帧判定为正确。

sents.en: For two-object clips, correctness additionally requires the static object in both phases: before entry, the static object must be detected and the entering object absent; after entry, both must be detected.
sents.zh: 对于双目标片段，正确性还额外要求两个阶段的静态目标：进入前，静态目标必须被检测到且进入目标不存在；进入后，两者都必须被检测到。

sents.en: Temporal accuracy is the mean per-video fraction of correct frames.
sents.zh: 时间准确性是每个视频中正确帧比例的均值。

sents.en: This frame-wise metric differs from the whole-video specification accuracy used on the TSG benchmark.
sents.zh: 这种逐帧指标不同于在 TSG 基准上使用的整段视频规范准确性。
